name: The Wanderer
aliases: Very pleasant swordswoman without a name
description: The Wanderer is a white-haired swordswoman, secretly the lost empress of Kamigawa, who was a planeswalker and is now a former planeswalker and the current Emperor of Kamigawa.

bio.text: Around age fourteen her spark was ignited when Tezzeret tried to control Kyodai with a prototype Reality Chip, leaving her spark unstable.

bio.text: She returned to Kamigawa, where the Reality Chip fused to her hand and stabilized her for a time, and she cleaved Jin-Gitaxias and helped free Kaito and Tamiyo.

citations.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.
"Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

bio.text: With her spark destabilizing she named Light-Paws her proxy to rule Kamigawa, then vanished from the plane again.

"Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

bio.text: She joined the planeswalkers who went to New Phyrexia, where she kept flickering back into the Blind Eternities, and she was later found frozen in an amber prison before warning that the invasion was upon them.

bio.text: On Kamigawa, empowered by Kyodai, she cut down the compleated Tamiyo to save Kaito and Nashi.

bio.text: She lost her spark in the Desparkening and used the chance to travel her home plane while Light-Paws ruled as regent.

citations.text: "The Wanderer", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Kamigawa", section "After the invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Later she told Ral she could not help because her spark was gone, and she led a rescue party into Duskmourn when Nashi went missing.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret retreats to the Seekers' Sanctum, where the Wanderer tracks him; he uses the bridge to redirect Ral's lightning.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret used the Planar Bridge to redirect Ral's lightning strikes

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After his victory Tezzeret uses the bridge to orchestrate the abandonment of his fortress, probably intending to be followed.
timeline.quote: he used the Planar Bridge to orchestrate the abandonment of his fortress

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ral and the Wanderer find Tezzeret on Alara; Tezzeret beats Ral and gives him his damaged arm as proof of a kill.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret showed mercy and gave Ral his damaged etherium arm to provide proof of a kill

citation.text: "Ral Zarek", section "Confrontation with Tezzeret". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret beats Ral in hand-to-hand combat and gives him his damaged arm as proof of the kill.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret showed mercy and gave Ral his damaged etherium arm to provide proof of the kill

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Around age fourteen, the Wanderer's spark is ignited when Tezzeret tries to control Kyodai with a prototype Reality Chip, leaving her spark unstable.
timeline.quote: The Chip left her spark unstable, causing the irregularities with her planeswalking ability.

citation.text: "The Wanderer", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer is lured to Ravnica and trapped there by the Immortal Sun, fighting the Eternals of Bolas' Dreadhorde.
timeline.quote: she fought against the Eternals of Bolas' Dreadhorde .

citation.text: "The Wanderer", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Chandra disables the Immortal Sun, the Wanderer stays to help the Gatewatch and survives the battle.
timeline.quote: She survived the battle.

citation.text: "The Wanderer", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer helps Ral Zarek track Tezzeret to his fortress on Alara, where she is knocked unconscious by a gargoyle and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Upon reaching Tezzeret, the Wanderer was knocked unconscious by the lead gargoyle and automatically planeswalked away.

citation.text: "The Wanderer", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer returns to Esper, finds Tezzeret's fortress abandoned, and reports it to the guilds on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: found evidence of an organized abandonment

citation.text: "The Wanderer", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vivien Reid sees the Wanderer cut down a monster on Ikoria before she planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: where Vivien Reid saw her cut down a monster before planeswalking away.

citation.text: "The Wanderer", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo reveals the Reality Chip and that the Wanderer and the emperor are one and the same.
timeline.quote: "The Wanderer and the emperor are one and the same."

citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The Reality Chip stirs, and a swordswoman cuts down the mech: the emperor, who is the Wanderer.
timeline.quote: The Wanderer.

citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo hides the henchmen with an invisibility spell, and the three planeswalkers flee Otawara.
timeline.quote: the three planeswalkers fled from Otawara in silence.

citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito, Tamiyo, and the emperor arrive in the emperor's garden in Eiganjo, and the emperor enters Kyodai's temple.
timeline.quote: She turned for the porch, slid open the door to Kyodai's temple, and disappeared inside.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Tamiyo find Kyodai reunited with the emperor, both in pain from the emperor's unstable spark.
timeline.quote: "Your spark is still unstable. You cannot remain on Kamigawa without help."

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo places the Reality Chip on the emperor's hand and it fuses to her flesh, stabilizing her for a time.
timeline.quote: the wires fused to her flesh like veins pulsing with energy.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The emperor reveals she has visions of the lab and that Jin-Gitaxias told Risona and the Uprisers of her return, so they will attack the palace.
timeline.quote: They plan to attack the palace imminently.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The emperor tells Kaito she heard of his search across the planes and nearly met him many times.
timeline.quote: "Sometimes I was only a step behind you.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Light-Paws and Eiko arrive and bow to the emperor, who orders the court to prepare against the Uprisers.
timeline.quote: We must prepare our forces at once."

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The emperor approves the plan to destroy the compound, and agrees to remain in Eiganjo.
timeline.quote: "I will remain here," she said at last.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito promises the emperor to free any captive kami before setting off the charge.
timeline.quote: "You have my word," Kaito replied.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer has a vision of the ambush and decides to planeswalk into the compound, with Eiko encouraging her to save Kaito.
timeline.quote: "They were ambushed by Tezzeret and Jin-Gitaxias."

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Using her bond with Kyodai to stabilize her spark, the Wanderer planeswalks to Tameshi's compound.
timeline.quote: the Wanderer planeswalked out of Eiganjo and into Tameshi's compound with a flash of light.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer cleaves Jin-Gitaxias with her sword and frees Kaito and Tamiyo from the surgical tables.
timeline.quote: The Wanderer brought her sword down like a blow from the heavens and cleaved Jin-Gitaxias from his neck to his chest.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer, Kaito and Tamiyo defeat the henchmen in the compound and hold Tezzeret paralyzed; the Wanderer decides to bring him to Kyodai.
timeline.quote: "Yes. We will decide his fate together."

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret takes control of the Reality Chip on the Wanderer's hand, destabilizing her spark and linking her to Kyodai in agony.
timeline.quote: no time to shout a warning before Tezzeret took control of the Reality Chip.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kyodai warns the Wanderer through the bond that Risona has brought an army to Eiganjo.
timeline.quote: Risona has brought an army.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo removes the chip from the Wanderer's hand and then places it on her own hand to pilot a surveillance mech to Eiganjo.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo lifted the Reality Chip to the back of her own hand and pressed the panel to her flesh.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer disables a surveillance mech and the group flies to Eiganjo on its back, carrying Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: The mech let out a ragged groan before lowering its body to the ground

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret wakes and flings Kaito's smoke devices, then jumps from the mech; Tamiyo loses control and the group jumps before the mech crashes.
timeline.quote: the mech exploding against the side of an Imperial apartment.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer fights Risona in Kyodai's temple and offers her surrender.
timeline.quote: "Drop your blade. There is no need for you to die this way."

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito knocks Risona unconscious with a thrown rock and she is bound, ending the battle.
timeline.quote: something flew across the room and cracked against the side of her skull, knocking her unconscious.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: With her spark destabilizing, the emperor names Light-Paws her proxy to rule Kamigawa with Kyodai's blessing.
timeline.quote: "You will be my proxy, and rule Kamigawa for as long as I am unable."

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The emperor's spark takes hold and she vanishes from Kamigawa again.
timeline.quote: The spark took hold of her, and the emperor once again vanished from Kamigawa.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer cuts Jin-Gitaxias out of the fight.
timeline.quote: Just as Jin-Gitaxias's victory seemed certain, the Wanderer appeared, her blade already in motion.

citation.text: Wanderer's Intervention (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Reality Chip tethers the Wanderer's wayward spark to Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: The Wanderer sighed in relief as the Reality Chip tethered her wayward spark to Kamigawa.

citation.text: Anchor to Reality (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer entrusts the Reality Chip to Tamiyo to keep it from Jin-Gitaxias.
timeline.quote: To keep the Reality Chip out of Jin-Gitaxias's hands, the Wanderer entrusted it to Tamiyo.

citation.text: Tamiyo's Safekeeping (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Yoshimaru waits daily, expecting the Wanderer to return for him.
timeline.quote: Day after day he sat there, knowing that the Wanderer would soon be back for him.

citation.text: Yoshimaru, Ever Faithful (Neon Dynasty Commander, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaito Shizuki and Tamiyo discover his base and fight him; the Wanderer cuts him in half.
timeline.quote: the Wanderer appeared suddenly and cut him in half.

citation.text: "Jin-Gitaxias", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: When Kaito is fourteen, the emperor disappears after being attacked by Tezzeret in the temple of Kyodai; Kaito leaves the castle to search for answers.
timeline.quote: Kaito left the castle and joined the Hyozan Reckoners to search for answers on his own.

citation.text: "Kaito Shizuki", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Tamiyo fight Jin-Gitaxias and Tezzeret to protect the returned emperor and Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: he and the moonfolk Planeswalker Tamiyo fought Jin-Gitaxias and Tezzeret to keep the returned emperor and their plane safe.

citation.text: "Kaito Shizuki", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer briefly returns to Kamigawa, meets Kaito, and reconnects with Kyodai thanks to the Reality Chip; she and Kyodai appoint Light-Paws acting Regent.
timeline.quote: she and the spirit agreed to appoint Light-Paws acting Regent of Kamigawa.

citation.text: "The Wanderer", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska, the Wanderer, Kaito, Tyvar and Lukka planeswalk in to join, and Kaya wraps the sylex for the journey.
timeline.quote: Soon, others began to planeswalk in.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer shakes Kaito and strikes him in the face, breaking the hypnotic spell so that he hears the battle around him.
timeline.quote: he realized that what he'd taken for the sound of waves was actually the sound of metal clashing on metal

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaito finds his sword and tanuki drone gone, and the Wanderer begins flickering out of the plane.
timeline.quote: He grabbed instinctively for his sword

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The group sets off across the metal desert toward the next landing zone, Nahiri warning that nothing Phyrexian can be trusted.
timeline.quote: You can't trust anything Phyrexian.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The group finds a statue of an elf containing Zendikari hedron stone, suspended in cables, and Nahiri declares him one of their own.
timeline.quote: That's a Zendikari hedron.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Nahiri attack the living cables and cut the statue free, and the Wanderer kneels beside him.
timeline.quote: until, with a loud snapping sound, the last one broke and dumped him to the ground

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The freed statue reverts to flesh and introduces himself as Tyvar Kell, Prince of Kaldheim.
timeline.quote: I am Tyvar Kell, Prince of Kaldheim.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer finally flickers away, unable to stay on the plane, having seen Kaito out of the first danger.
timeline.quote: He turned to the Wanderer, intending to say something to boost her spirits and bolster her strength.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer returns to the razed camp too late and finds her companions gone.
timeline.quote: She had returned from the Blind Eternities too late, and they were lost.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Lukka follows an angry cry and finds Nissa and the Wanderer fighting a Phyrexian construct on a bough.
timeline.quote: Lukka had seen them before: Nissa, and the woman was called . . . the Wanderer.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer decapitates the first creature, then vanishes with a flicker of light.
timeline.quote: Then, with a strange flicker of light, the Wanderer vanished.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer warns them of a Phyrexian monstrosity that attacks Nissa; the centaur hulk wraps wires around Lukka's spine and he kills the attacker with his harpoon.
timeline.quote: Veiny wires sprouted from its torso, plunging through his skin and wiggling through his gut to wrap around his spine.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The group is attacked by leech-like creatures and a mother-beast; Lukka frees his Phyrexian by slicing through the mother-monstrosity with his now-metallic hands.
timeline.quote: He pulled apart a lip of flesh and freed his Phyrexian.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer reveals Vorinclex is nearby and recovered from his journey to Kaldheim, and Lukka and Nissa decide to attack him.
timeline.quote: We need to take him down before he hurts anyone else.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Nissa, horrified, backs away as Lukka advances on her, and the Wanderer flickers in to shield her and tells her to run.
timeline.quote: Nissa, run!

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Teferi recognizes the described woman and her hat as the Wanderer.
timeline.quote: Not just any wanderer: the Wanderer.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Queen Wezna tosses Teferi an amber prison holding the frozen Wanderer.
timeline.quote: Small, frozen in time, likely moments after planeswalking, a warrior mid-strike.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: A creed leader breaks the amber prison and the Wanderer is freed.
timeline.quote: the prison snapped, bursting open with a sharp report

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer learns she has been in Zhalfir a month, and Teferi reasons the anchor failed.
timeline.quote: The anchor failed,

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer tells them New Phyrexia's invasion is upon them before she flickers away.
timeline.quote: New Phyrexia's invasion is upon us,

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: On New Phyrexia Kaito is incapacitated by Norn's barrier and rescued by the Wanderer, then travels with Tyvar and Nahiri to Mirrex.
timeline.quote: After being rescued by The Wanderer, he traveled with Tyvar and Nahiri to Mirrex .

citation.text: "Kaito Shizuki", section "Against the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka is compleated, fully merging with his companion, and Glissa orders him to capture Nissa alive.
timeline.quote: By the time he fought Glissa and Vorinclex , he fully bonded with his companion and the two became one.

citation.text: "Lukka", section "Against the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nashi tries to reason with the compleated Tamiyo, who is felled by the Wanderer; her past self's projection comforts him.
timeline.quote: She refused and was felled by the Wanderer .

timeline.summary: The Wanderer cuts Jin-Gitaxias in two and Tezzeret rebuilds him.
